pairs.target: qù kàn sè lā nàrì , tǎ wéi xiān xiàng xuégōng liú le qùxiàng , shuō tiānhēi qián huílái .
pairs.english: On the day he visited Sela, Tavi first left word at the academy: back before dark.
pairs.hanzi: 去看瑟拉那日，塔维先向学宫留了去向，说天黑前回来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yǐ zài zǎochén chéngchē fǎn fēng zhàn , línzǒu bǎ bàogào de shōutiáo jiāogěi tā , jiào tā liú hǎo , méi zài tì tā bǎ wǎnghòu měi yírì dōu pái shàng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had taken the morning cart to Wind Trestle, handing him the report receipt before leaving, telling him to keep it without planning every day ahead for him.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡已在早晨乘车返风栈，临走把报告的收条交给他，叫他留好，没再替他把往后每一日都排上。

pairs.target: huī ào de xiàngkǒu zhèngzài liàng yìchuáng bèi miàn , tǎ wéi cèshēn zuànguòqù , mén hái méiqiāo , biàn tīngjiàn sè lā zài lǐtou tóng rén zhēng yìzhī pén .
pairs.english: A quilt cover dried at Ash Hollow's alley entrance. Ducking past, Tavi heard Sela arguing over a basin with someone inside before knocking.
pairs.hanzi: 灰坳的巷口正在晾一床被面，塔维侧身钻过去，门还没敲，便听见瑟拉在里头同人争一只盆。

pairs.target: línjū shuō qiánrì jiè de shì zhè zhī , tā shuō zìjǐ péndǐ yǒu yídào āo , bùnéng yīn dōu shì hēi de biàn yìng shuō yíyàng .
pairs.english: The neighbor said it was the one she'd borrowed; Sela's had a dent underneath, she said, and blackness didn't make them the same.
pairs.hanzi: 邻居说前日借的是这只，她说自己盆底有一道凹，不能因都是黑的便硬说一样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn zìjǐ xié shàng zhān de huī , hūrán juéde ruò zhàn zài ménwài zài tīng yíhuìer , yě búhuì yǒurén fāxiàn tā huílái le . "
pairs.english: Looking at ash on his shoes, Tavi felt he might listen outside a while without anyone knowing he'd returned.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维低头看自己鞋上沾的灰，忽然觉得若站在门外再听一会儿，也不会有人发现他回来了。
“

pairs.target: yǒukōng kànrènào , méikòng jìnlái ? "
pairs.english: “Time to watch, no time to come in?”
pairs.hanzi: 有空看热闹，没空进来？”

pairs.target: sè lā shuō .
pairs.english: Sela said.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn jìnqù , nà línjū jiàn le tā , xiào zhe jiāng pén līn zǒu , shuōmíng rì zài zhǎo .
pairs.english: He hurried inside. Smiling on seeing him, the neighbor carried off the basin: she'd look again tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧进去，那邻居见了他，笑着将盆拎走，说明日再找。

pairs.target: sè lā méi dāngchǎng zhuī dào ménwài , xiān kàn tā de liǎn , yòu jiào tā bǎ bāo fàngxià .
pairs.english: Sela didn't pursue her outside, first studying his face and telling him to put his bag down.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没当场追到门外，先看他的脸，又叫他把包放下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō jīnrì zhī dài yìdiǎn dōngxī , búshì huíjiā zhù , huà yì chūkǒu biàn juéde yìng , máng tiān zìjǐ hái dé huíqù shàngkè .
pairs.english: He said he'd only brought a few things, wasn't staying; it sounded harsh, so he added he had classes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说今日只带一点东西，不是回家住，话一出口便觉得硬，忙添自己还得回去上课。

pairs.target: tā shuō tīngjiàn le , liǎngzhī ěrduo dōu tīngjiàn le , ràng tā xiān zuò .
pairs.english: She had heard him with both ears, Sela said: sit first.
pairs.hanzi: 她说听见了，两只耳朵都听见了，让他先坐。

pairs.target: zhuōbiān nà zhī zhēnxiànhé kāi zhe , lán huāzhēn tào de huā réng cháowài .
pairs.english: The sewing box stood open beside the table, blue flowers still outward on the needle wrap.
pairs.hanzi: 桌边那只针线盒开着，蓝花针套的花仍朝外。

pairs.target: tā yǐ shōudào tā chāo lái de chí ān dìèr fēngxìn , ā nán de míngzì yā zài hégài xià , zhǐbiān duō yìgēn fèng yī de xiàn .
pairs.english: She had received his full copy of Chi An's second letter; A-Nan's name lay under the lid beside sewing thread.
pairs.hanzi: 她已收到他抄来的迟安第二封信，阿楠的名字压在盒盖下，纸边多一根缝衣的线。

pairs.target: yuánlái fú lán nà fēngxìn lìng zhé zhe zài dǐxià , méi yīn yǒu le xīn míngzì jiù bèi nádào yíchù jiē chéng yìzhāng tú .
pairs.english: Fulan's original stayed folded separately underneath, not turned into a joined map because a new name had come.
pairs.hanzi: 原来芙兰那封信另折着在底下，没因有了新名字就被拿到一处接成一张图。

pairs.target: sè lā jiāng zhēn fàngwěn , wèn ā nán zhè liǎnggè zì jiūjìng shìbushì nà nǚrén zìjǐ shuō de .
pairs.english: Setting her needle safely down, Sela asked if the woman had called herself A-Nan.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉将针放稳，问阿楠这两个字究竟是不是那女人自己说的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō xìn lǐ zhī xiě yuànlǐ rén zhèyàng jiào , yě méi shuō tā jiùshì ā qiǎo zhù de nà jiā .
pairs.english: Only others in the courtyard had called her that, Tavi said, and the letter hadn't said she hosted Aqiao.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说信里只写院里人这样叫，也没说她就是阿巧住的那家。

pairs.target: sè lā diǎntóu , shuō nà biàn liú zhe zhèyàng , zìjǐ kàn dé míngbái , búyòng tā zài jiǎng dé gèng xiàng yì huíshì .
pairs.english: Sela nodded: leave it so, she'd understood; no need for him to make it sound more definite.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉点头，说那便留着这样，自己看得明白，不用他再讲得更像一回事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng jiāng fùhé cóngtóu shuō yíbiàn , sè lā què shēnshǒu lánzhù , shuō xiān jiǎng fēng zhàn nà zuò yā dào rén tóushàng de shān .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to recount his review from the start, but Sela stopped him: first the mountain falling on someone's head.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想将复核从头说一遍，瑟拉却伸手拦住，说先讲风栈那座压到人头上的山。

pairs.target: tā lèng le yíxià , tā zhǐzhǐ qián yìfēngxìn , shuō zìjǐ kànguò , hái niàn gěi gébì tīng , jiǎng dào gǔshǒu zuǐlǐsāi bǐng , nà rén xiào dé bǎ zhēn dōu diào le .
pairs.english: At his surprise she pointed to the earlier letter; she'd read it aloud next door, and at the drummer's mouthful of bread the listener had laughed and dropped her needle.
pairs.hanzi: 他愣了一下，她指指前一封信，说自己看过，还念给隔壁听，讲到鼓手嘴里塞饼，那人笑得把针都掉了。

pairs.target: tā biàn cóng jiào gǔshǒu chū pù shuōqǐ , jiǎng hòulái xiǎohái wèn mù rén méi bízi , sè lā yě xiào , xiào wán yòu shuō dù chéng nà nǚér ruòzhēn duō zuàn yígè kǒng , wěi guǎn biàn wèibì chuī dé xiǎng .
pairs.english: He began with fetching the drummer, then the child asking about the figure's missing nose. Sela laughed too, then said if Du Cheng's daughter really drilled another hole, the pipe might not sound.
pairs.hanzi: 他便从叫鼓手出铺说起，讲后来小孩问木人没鼻子，瑟拉也笑，笑完又说杜澄那女儿若真多钻一个孔，苇管便未必吹得响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā zěnme zhīdào , tā shuō zìjǐ bù zhīdào wěi guǎn , zhīdào rén zǒng bùnéng shénme dòng dōu suíyì duō kāi yígè , ràng tā bié yòu dàngzhēn jì dào shí zuò zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: How did she know? Not pipes, she said, but that you couldn't simply put extra holes everywhere. Don't take it seriously and put it in his practical notes again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问她怎么知道，她说自己不知道苇管，知道人总不能什么洞都随意多开一个，让他别又当真记到实作纸上。

pairs.target: wǔhòu liǎng rén jiàng ménbiān nà zhī jiù dèng nuó dào tàiyáng lǐ .
pairs.english: That afternoon they moved the old doorway stool into sunlight.
pairs.hanzi: 午后两人将门边那只旧凳挪到太阳里。

pairs.target: sè lā mànmàn zuòxià , xīgài wān shí réng tíng le yíxià , què néng zìjǐ jiāng jiǎo wǎngqián shēn , búbì tā fú zhe .
pairs.english: Sela sat slowly, pausing as her knees bent, but could stretch her feet herself without his support.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉慢慢坐下，膝盖弯时仍停了一下，却能自己将脚往前伸，不必他扶着。

pairs.target: tā ná yíjiàn yào bǔ de yīfu , tǎ wéi tì tā chuānxiàn , dìyīhuí méi chuān jìn , jìng jí dé jiāng xiàntóu cuō sàn , sè lā kàn tā yìyǎn , shuō xuégōng huílái de rén yě háishì dé jiǎnxiàn tóu .
pairs.english: Taking a garment to mend, she had Tavi thread the needle. Missing first try, he rubbed the thread end apart in impatience. Even back from the academy, she said, you still had to trim thread ends.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿一件要补的衣服，塔维替她穿线，第一回没穿进，竟急得将线头搓散，瑟拉看他一眼，说学宫回来的人也还是得剪线头。

pairs.target: tāmen zuò le hěn jiǔ , huà búshì yìzhí yǒu .
pairs.english: They sat a long time, not talking constantly.
pairs.hanzi: 他们坐了很久，话不是一直有。

pairs.target: yǒushí xiànglǐ yǒurén jīngguò , sè lā biàn jiào yìshēng , yǒushí tā dītóu fèng , tā kàn wūyán de yǐngzi wǎng xiàyí .
pairs.english: Sela called to people in the alley, or bent to sew while he watched the eaves' shadow move down.
pairs.hanzi: 有时巷里有人经过，瑟拉便叫一声，有时她低头缝，他看屋檐的影子往下移。

pairs.target: chí ān , ā qiǎo hé nàge jiào ā nán de rén dōu méiyǒu cóng zhè duàn ānjìng lǐ xiāoshī , yě méiyǒu jǐ dào liǎng rén zhōngjiān , jiào tāmen yídìng dé shuōchū shénme jiélùn .
pairs.english: Chi An, Aqiao and A-Nan hadn't vanished from the quiet, nor pressed between them demanding a conclusion.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安、阿巧和那个叫阿楠的人都没有从这段安静里消失，也没有挤到两人中间，叫他们一定得说出什么结论。

pairs.target: línzǒu , sè lā jiāng nà zhī zhēnzhèng āo dǐ de pén cóng chuáng xià lā chūlái , jiào tā kàn : hái zài .
pairs.english: Before he left, Sela pulled the real dented basin from under the bed: still here.
pairs.hanzi: 临走，瑟拉将那只真正凹底的盆从床下拉出来，叫他看：还在。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nà línjū míngrì lái zěnmebàn , tā shuō ràng tā lái , zìjǐ yòu méi shuō tā míngrì yídìng zhǎo búdào .
pairs.english: What if the neighbor came tomorrow? Let her, Sela said: she hadn't said the woman certainly wouldn't find it tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那邻居明日来怎么办，她说让她来，自己又没说她明日一定找不到。

pairs.target: tā sòngdào ménkǒu , dītóu kàn tā de xié , jiào tā jìn xuégōng yǐqián bǎ huī pāi jìng , bié dāng zìjǐ hái zài jiālǐ .
pairs.english: At the door she looked at his shoes: brush the ash off before entering the academy, don't think you're still home.
pairs.hanzi: 她送到门口，低头看他的鞋，叫他进学宫以前把灰拍净，别当自己还在家里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying , zǒu dào xiàngkǒu huítóu , tā yǐ zài jiāng bèi miàn de jiǎo chóngxīn jiá hǎo .
pairs.english: He agreed. Looking back from the alley entrance, he saw her already fastening the quilt cover's corner again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应，走到巷口回头，她已在将被面的角重新夹好。
